original_test_intent: Verify the Version field of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 chassis record equals the approved enclosure mechanical/assembly revision and remains stable after reboot, without substituting BIOS, system or baseboard versions.
original_method: Capture all Type 3 records, select the target enclosure using serial/asset/type/BOM data, extract its Version, compare with the approved chassis assembly revision and normalization policy, reboot and repeat on the same enclosure.
manual_activity: A user approves the enclosure/version mapping and reboot plan. Record-scoped collection, comparison and persistence checking are automatable.
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; retain all Type 3 records and errors.
Do not substitute Type 0 BIOS, Type 1 system, Type 2 board or firmware Version values.
Do not assume the first enclosure record; reject placeholder, wrong-layer and wrong-enclosure values.
Protect correlated serial/asset identifiers in evidence.
Stop on ambiguity, revision drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 3/tool/BOM evidence, bind the target enclosure and compare its Version before and after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, guess whether a PCB/assembly/marketing revision is equivalent or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the enclosure mapping, authoritative chassis revision and equivalence rules.
Resolve mechanical, assembly and marketing-version discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 3 restriction is useful, but grep does not bind Version to the intended enclosure, discards errors and uses insecure transport assumptions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 3 output with tool/errors, select the enclosure through correlated identity fields and compare only that record's Version.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 3 Version scope, chassis script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the Type 3 record to chassis serial/asset/type and BOM, compare the raw Version with the approved mechanical or assembly revision under an explicit equivalence policy, and retain the identical mapping across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 3 systems, including multi-enclosure platforms.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, enclosure and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved chassis assembly/BOM revision recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds enclosure provenance and revision-layer semantics without changing the source field.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mechanical, assembly, PCB and marketing versions may not be interchangeable.

project_override_considerations: A project may define the authoritative revision layer and permitted formatting for its enclosure, but must identify the exact Type 3 record and retain the raw value.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected chassis Version/layer, enclosure/BOM mapping and tool version
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 records plus selected revision comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and persistence criterion consistently target Type 3 Version; project revision semantics are not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and method are clear; revision layer and expected value are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the Type 3 read while adding exact enclosure selection and visible errors.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps version-layer separation and recovery but corrects capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds multi-enclosure handling, revision equivalence policy and identifier protection.

review_improvement: Prevents a Version from the wrong identity layer or enclosure record from satisfying the chassis-specific case.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core read, record selection, compare and reboot operations are software-controlled after the project supplies its authoritative chassis revision.
